title: Fix protocol method signatures in plugin-hono-server and plugin-msw
body:
Protocol interface changed from individual parameters to structured request objects in recent refactor. Plugins were still using old signatures.

## Changes

Updated protocol method calls to use object parameters:

**Before:**
```typescript
await p.findData(object, query);
await p.getData(object, id);
await p.createData(object, data);
await p.getMetaItems(type);
```

**After:**
```typescript
await p.findData({ object, query });
await p.getData({ object, id });
await p.createData({ object, data });
await p.getMetaItems({ type });
```

## Affected Files

- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/hono-plugin.ts` - 16 method calls
- `packages/plugins/plugin-msw/src/msw-plugin.ts` - 11 method calls

All changes follow the same pattern: individual parameters → destructured request object.
